business_summary: Jiangxi Hungpai New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of functional silanes and nano-silicon materials, and other chemical additives in China and internationally. The company provides alkyl silane coupling agent, amino silane coupling agent, anti adhesion agent, chloroalkyl silane coupling agent, epoxy silane coupling agent, silicone oil, fumed silica, phenyl silane coupling agent, silicate ester, sulfur silane coupling agent, thiocyanato silane coupling agent, and vinyl silanes coupling agent. It also manufactures and sale polyvinyl alcohol, emulsions, coatings, adhesive powders, and white latex; heating services; other chemicals; and sale and trade of general chemicals. In addition, the company manufacture and sale of synthetic materials and rubbers; thermal and sound insulation materials; fibers and composite materials; electronic; plastic products; ecological and environmental materials; bio-based materials; machinery and equipment; technology development, consultation, exchange, transfer, and promotion; trade brokerage; domestic trade agency; import and export of goods, toxic chemical, and technology; and specialty chemical products. Its products are used in rubber products, construction, textiles, automobiles, leather, papermaking, coatings, and pharmaceuticals. Jiangxi Hungpai New Material Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is based in Jingdezhen, China.
